# Daniel B. Faizakoff P.C.

> A boutique law firm founded in 2003, serving families and closely-held
> businesses in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut. Three senior attorneys
> practicing estate planning, probate and estate administration, and small
> business and corporate law. Offices in Manhattan and Stamford.

Contact: dbf@legalesq.com | +1-212-619-3100
Offices: 420 Lexington Avenue, Suite 2400, New York, NY 10170
         112 Prospect Street, 3rd Floor, Stamford, CT 06901

## Practice Areas

- [Estate Planning](https://legalesq.com/practice-areas/estate-planning): Wills, revocable trusts, durable powers of attorney, health care proxies, wealth-transfer planning, planning for young families and special situations.
- [Probate & Estate Administration](https://legalesq.com/practice-areas/probate): Probate proceedings, intestate administration, executor and administrator representation, post-death tax filings, estate distribution.
- [Small Business & Corporate](https://legalesq.com/practice-areas/business): Entity formation, contracts, NDAs, transactions, employment, intellectual property, outside general counsel.

## Attorneys

- [Daniel B. Faizakoff](https://legalesq.com/about/daniel-faizakoff): Founder and senior partner. Estate planning, probate, corporate law.
- [Richard H. Wender](https://legalesq.com/about/richard-wender): Of Counsel. Tax-driven estate and corporate practice. NYU LL.M. in Taxation, former SEC Branch Chief.
- [Ripal J. Gajjar](https://legalesq.com/about/ripal-gajjar): Of Counsel. Corporate and transactional counsel, commercial litigation.
